newsitem.title: CHINA: China listed power firms EPS beats market in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China listed power firms EPS beats market in 1996.

text.p: The average earnings per share (EPS) of China's domestically-listed power companies outpaced the overall market in 1996, the official China Daily Business Weekly reported on Sunday.

The average EPS for 17 locally-listed power companies was 0.39 yuan for 1996, 33 percent higher than the average for all the listed companies on the Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock Exchanges, the newspaper said.

The power companies registered satisfactory performances in 1996, helped by China's growing demand for electricity to fuel economic growth, it said, adding the government plans tax breaks and other favourable policies to ensure continued development of the industry.
